simple.meaning: קִמּוֹשׁ (qimmôwsh) is a Hebrew action word meaning “a prickly plant.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 2 times in Isaiah, Hosea, beginning at Isaiah 34:13. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to קִמּוֹשׁ (H7057) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: קִמּוֹשׁ (qimmôwsh) / H7057 is traced through Isaiah 34:13, Hosea 9:6 with source-language evidence and verse context.
